title: THEN / NOW
rule: every row is one change made to a product: an earlier state stays grey, a problem has only its measured part struck while its result writes in, a new product says Shipped with its Result, and own projects say what they are with one Detail
description: Nine rows: five changes to client products, then a group of four own projects. The page opens on the care-management platform that many client organizations use: the first screen holds the care app's vitals card (a labelled recreation) over the measured billing report drawn to scale. At load '16 times and timed out' is struck, 'It asks 2 times and finishes.' writes in, the struck 16 gives way to 2, the bar shrinks to 2/16 of its length, and the line runs to the ringed 2. Then Bayyinah TV (landing page with the app on laptop, desktop, phone and tablet; the ring on the phone and tablet), Read to Feed, Viva Fresh and Design System v2 (with the team). 'Own projects' (one app, two concepts and a studio website) shows Offday (light shifts screen, ring on a Needs cover shift), OFFBEAT (its record sleeve, whose dots are the drum pattern), FORM (the Trefoil and its ringed formula) and Snaxx Tech (all the site's files 28 MB -> 9.5 MB, its bars shrink when the row is shown). Every screen sits on a paper mat inside the blue field.
signature: Literata for every sentence and Anton for the labels (THEN, NOW, SHIPPED, RESULT, BUILT, MADE, CONCEPT, DETAIL), the row numbers, the tray and the three diagrams; ink #121212 on paper #F6F5F0, earlier and problem text #57544C (6.9:1), struck part #6B6860 (5.0:1), one accent #2348D8 for the NOW band, the line, the ring and a full-height field from half the column gap to the screen edge (white on accent 7.5:1, caption white at 86%). The diagrams are paper plates on the field: old numbers in ink, new numbers and bars in accent. Desktop: a 1344 px grid, 48 px gutters, the log at the left and a 640 x 560 screen on a 12 px paper mat at the right, sticky; the line is accent on paper and white on the field (a hard gradient stop at the field edge). A row becomes current when its top passes 42% of the viewport and settles for 160 ms. A fixed row strikes its measured parts (200 ms), the NOW band wipes in by clip-path (260 ms after 200 ms), the weight bars shrink by transform scaleX (260 ms after 200 ms), then the line draws (180 ms) and the ring fades in (120 ms). Plates cross-fade in 200 ms. Keyboard jumps are instant. Fonts wait at most 120 ms, then metric-matched fallbacks stay for the visit (CLS 0). Phone: the frame pins at the top on an accent band, 4:3, at most 436 px wide, with phone crops and the ring only. Reduced motion: everything is in its end state and nothing moves.
holdback: Lowest: original, 7/10. The frame is still projector's sticky frame beside a scrolling log, and the strike-and-write is year-stack's; the paper words beside the blue product field is the own part. The 16 -> 2 billing result is in the first screen of other drafts too (as a row, not as their lead), so the message overlaps; then-now is the only draft that leads with it. The care card is a recreation: no real care screen may be shown, so the lead has app UI with invented data and the measured result is a diagram. On the phone the plate is too short for both, so it shows the card and the row carries the numbers (no ring there). FORM is cropped at 0.89 of its CSS pixels (formula text 11.5 px): no 640 x 560 crop holds the Trefoil and its formula whole at 1.0. Bayyinah TV and Snaxx Tech are 1440 px captures, so on a 2x screen they are enlarged about 2x; no 2x capture exists. Offday has no public link (private repository); the caption says so. A late recreation mount adds a layout shift of 0.0001-0.0003 at 1024-1440.
